ways_and_means.label: Ways and Means advances to HM Government

apf_loan.label: Loan to Asset Purchase Facility
apf_loan.equivalence_note: code to locate in IADB tree Assets; Apr-2026 value 553158

tfsme.label: TFSME aggregate drawings (financed by reserve creation)

government_account.label: HMG deposits at BoE — NOT published as a separate Weekly Report line
government_account.equivalence_note: HMG deposits at BoE — NOT published as a separate Weekly Report line

osf_lending_usage.label: Operational Standing Facility — lending, average outstanding by maintenance period
osf_lending_usage.equivalence_note: published per MPC maintenance period (~6-weekly), lagged — event flag, not a weekly gauge

ctrf.label: Contingent Term Repo Facility (CTRF)
ctrf.equivalence_note: emergency/episodic backstop — any value > 0 is an event flag

fx_public_securities.label: Foreign currency public securities issued (liability)
fx_public_securities.equivalence_note: BoE's own FX bonds; not sterling liquidity

osf_deposit_usage.label: Operational Standing Facility — deposit, average outstanding by maintenance period

policy_balance_sheet.label: Policy Balance Sheet (assets) = STR + LTR + TFSME + APF loan + £ bonds
policy_balance_sheet.usd_analog: WALCL policy portfolio (no TGA term: HMG deposits not in the Weekly Report)
policy_balance_sheet.equivalence_note: NOT 'Net Liquidity': the Weekly Report has no HMG deposits line, so the USD WALCL−TGA−RRP construct is not buildable weekly. Primary weekly liquidity reading = reserves (RPWB56A) + price (SONIA − Bank Rate).

abs.origin: v4.3 netLiq Δ: <1% green, 1–2% amber, >2% red (as absolute change)
v4.3 netLiq Δ: <1% green, 1–2% amber, >2% red (as absolute change)

repo_offset.label: Repo offset = STR + long-term ops (demand-driven)
repo_offset.equivalence_note: demand-driven: level is not a policy signal; watch abrupt changes

repo_dependence_ratio.label: Repo dependence = (STR + LTR) / reserves
repo_dependence_ratio.equivalence_note: share of reserves supplied by repo (BoE: ~1/4 in Mar 2026). Informational while SONIA − Bank Rate < 0; escalates only with price confirmation

qt_pace.label: QT pace = Δ APF loan, 26-week average per week (negative = sales + maturities)

currency_drain.label: Currency drain (−Δ notes in circulation, autonomous)
currency_drain.equivalence_note: Outside money: not subtracted from the policy balance sheet (cross-currency rule)

reserves_vs_pmrr_ceiling.label: Reserves − PMRR ceiling (515 bn)
reserves_vs_pmrr_ceiling.equivalence_note: the clock to watch under QT: weeks to the PMRR ceiling at the current pace

balance_sheet_phase.label: Balance-sheet phase
balance_sheet_phase.note: APF run-off (gilt sales + maturities) with reserves supplied on demand via STR/ILTR

str_net_daily.label: STR net flow (+ allocated, − matured; by operation)

apf_sales_daily.label: APF gilt sales settled (− reserves, proceeds)

repo_maturities_next_4w.label: STR/ILTR/CTRF maturing in the next 4 weeks (scheduled drain)

apf_redemptions_next_12m.label: APF gilt redemptions in the next 12 months (HMT → BoE, no reserve effect; refinancing need)

exchequer_residual_weekly.label: Exchequer residual = ΔR − ΔSTR − ΔLTR − ΔAPF − ΔTFSME − ΔW&M + ΔNotes (weekly identity)
exchequer_residual_weekly.equivalence_note: Exchequer + unobserved clients (foreign central banks, CCPs); cleaned per ADJUDICACION_METRICAS_GBP.md 4b
